description: Deploy one of the account's saved servers into a free server slot, bringing it online. This uses a slot the account already pays for and never buys anything. List saved servers with list_instances using status "archived", and check slots with get_available_slots first. If the slot has less RAM than the game wants, this reports the shortfall and you must relay it and get the user's go-ahead before retrying with acknowledge_requirements.

acknowledge_requirements.description: Set true only after telling the user the slot has less RAM than the game recommends and getting their explicit approval to deploy anyway.

auto_start.description: Start the server as soon as it finishes deploying. Defaults to false.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be deployed, naming the server and the slot it will occupy and getting their approval.

instance.description: Id (preferred) or exact name of the saved server to deploy.

service_id.description: Which free slot to deploy into, from get_available_slots. Optional when exactly one slot is free.

name: deploy_instance
title: Deploy Saved Server
